title: Yellowed Brown German Pork Roast
description: A spicy and comforting German dish featuring green cardamom pods and a cheese-pull, made with a roast and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together brown sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork roast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the pork roast in a large Dutch oven and add the crushed green cardamom pods.
Roast the pork in the preheated oven for 2 hours, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Slice the pork into thin strips and place it back in the Dutch oven.
Top the pork with shredded cheddar cheese and sour cream.
Return the Dutch oven to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
